protocol.finite_sample_limit: FP <= floor(alpha * calibration_count); strict Normal prior maximum and nonincreasing observed FP required
protocol.limitation: The permanent pool was available to allocation validation; it is not a fresh independent calibration sample
protocol.pool: Same seed-specific permanent Normal TRAIN holdout for every method; never optimized
protocol.replay_la: Same Replay weights and total tau; baseline tau=1 plus delta, no extra training or inference
protocol.rule: First adjacent initial-grid bracket when present; otherwise expand toward the missing infeasible lower or feasible upper endpoint; retain feasible upper endpoint after 50 bisections
protocol.test_role: Evaluate selected total tau only; test metrics never select tau or the expansion range

cer_mapping.algorithm: Stage 1: CE weighted by new/seen class count plus old-output softmax distillation weighted by old/seen. Stage 2: freeze network and older corrections, fit alpha/beta for only new logits.

architecture_engineering_defaults.order: Conv1D-ReLU-MaxPool1D-BatchNorm1D twice; flatten; Linear128-ReLU; expanding class head

cer_mapping.architecture_paper: Two convolutional layers with pooling and normalization, dense expanding output; native Conv2D replaced with Conv1D.

engineering_defaults.bias_optimizer: SGD momentum .9, lr .1, 200 epochs, beta penalty .05*beta^2
engineering_defaults.correction_selection: Seeded random 20 rows per introduced class (10% of 200); persistent, excluded from backbone training and herding.
engineering_defaults.rare_class: Underfill unique replay slots when fewer than 180 eligible rows; never duplicate rows to fill memory.
engineering_defaults.reference: FACIL BiC defaults transferred, not asserted as Cerasuolo numeric settings
engineering_defaults.stopping: New-current-class TRAIN-only split: min(200, ceil(10% of eligible rows)); excludes permanent holdout and BiC correction; no old full-pool validation access.

cer_mapping.input: Registered preprocessed flow vector in unchanged feature order, one channel; NOT native 10-packet by 4-field input.
cer_mapping.memory: 200 slots per seen class including Normal: up to 180 herded replay plus 20 correction rows. Old replay/correction rows retained without refresh. Paper uses 25/class.

method_choice.metric: all-class macro F1 Drop, lower is better
method_choice.reason: Lowest reported all-class F1 Drop among all eight CIL methods on every dataset; not a fallback or a new aggregate ranking.

cer_mapping.other_adaptations: Registered multi-stage class order and splits replace native one-new-attack runs; no new input preprocessing, no TEST model selection; ordinary BiC CE, not the shared class-balanced CE.

training_override.family: All new CER formal cells use this override; native UNSW remains historical sensitivity evidence, never mixed into this family.
training_override.reason: CIC17 native seed10 stopped at 3304.719 s before first task completion; not an algorithm performance result.
training_override.rows: Same partition as native; reserved TRAIN stopping rows retained for diagnostic loss only, not model selection.
training_override.stage1: Adam lr 0.001, batch 256, max(8 full epochs, 2000 optimizer steps), no early stopping or learning-rate decay; final iterate.
training_override.stage2: Separate BiC correction unchanged: SGD lr 0.1 momentum 0.9, 200 epochs, beta penalty 0.05; reported separately.
